headline: Petrobras and Rio Tinto Report Record Production and Lithium Plant Investments
summary: Petrobras reported record oil and gas production of 3.512 million boed in the third quarter of 2026. Meanwhile, Rio Tinto inaugurated $1.4 billion lithium plants in South America alongside multi-billion-dollar investments in Guinea and South Africa.
why: Petrobras and Rio Tinto are major global energy and mining conglomerates whose output and capital expenditures significantly influence commodity markets and international mining supply chains.
why_moved: Record production updates from major energy firms directly affect global supply expectations for crude oil and key transition minerals.
